product.description: Monoprice™1‑Gang Flexible Split Plate, WhitePractical Solution for Concealing and Routing Multiple Low‑Voltage ConnectionsThe 2‑Gang Flexible Split Plate, White, is a practical, stylish, and easy‑to‑install solution for managing multiple cables in residential and commercial low‑voltage applications. Designed to fit seamlessly into modern AV, data, and networking setups, this split plate offers both functionality and a clean, professional appearance.Engineered for convenience, the 2‑Gang Flexible Split Plate features a flexible split opening that allows cables to pass through easily while reducing the risk of damage or wear. This design makes it ideal for routing HDMI®, coaxial, speaker wire, network cables‑up to 12 total‑and well as other low‑voltage connections from behind the wall to entertainment centers, workstations, or office equipment. The flexible opening also provides enough give to accommodate bulkier cables without the need for additional connectors or strain relief, making installation faster and more efficient.The split configuration is particularly useful for retrofit projects where cables are already in place. Unlike traditional plates that require threading all cables before installation, the split design lets you install the plate around existing cables, saving time and effort. This feature is especially valuable for professional installers and DIY enthusiasts working with complex home theater or office wiring systems.The white finish delivers a sleek, neutral look that blends effortlessly with most walls and décor. Whether in a living room, office, or conference room, the plate maintains a neat, clutter‑free appearance, concealing cable entry points for a polished result.Installation is simple and secure. The 2‑Gang Flexible Split Plate is designed to mount directly onto a standard 2‑gang low‑voltage mounting bracket, ensuring a snug fit and reliable hold. Standard screw holes align perfectly with most electrical box configurations, making this plate suitable for both new construction and retrofit installations.Built with durability in mind, the flexible opening is crafted from high‑quality materials that can withstand repeated use without tearing or losing shape. It is both practical and long‑lasting, offering years of dependable performance.Whether you are setting up a new media room, upgrading a commercial AV system, or organizing office wiring, the 2‑Gang Flexible Split Plate, White, delivers the perfect balance of functionality, ease, and style. It's a smart choice for anyone who values efficiency and a professional‑looking installation.Designed for clean and professional cable management in home or office installationsFlexible split opening
